# Superi.ge

> Superi.ge (სუპერი) is a Georgian online store, operating since 2016, that sells consumer electronics, home appliances, climate equipment, computers, kitchen appliances, tools, garden, sports, kids', pet and furniture products from official suppliers, with delivery across Georgia. The site is in Georgian and all prices are in Georgian lari (GEL, ₾).

- Website: https://superi.ge/ (Georgian only; page URLs use Latin transliteration, e.g. `/mobiluri-teleponebi/`).
- Operator: შპს „ბესთ სოლუშენ 2022“ (Best Solution 2022 LLC), identification code 430806648.
- Phone: +995 32 2 04 44 44, mobile +995 592 444 000, e-mail: info@superi.ge
- Address: Mukhran Machavariani St. 62, Tbilisi, Georgia (მუხრან მაჭავარიანის 62, თბილისი).
- Online orders are accepted 24/7; customer service works Monday–Saturday, 10:00–21:00 (Tbilisi time).
- Payment: bank card, cash on delivery, bank transfer, and installments (ნაწილ-ნაწილ გადახდა) through TBC Bank, Bank of Georgia and Credo Bank.

## Store Policies

- [Delivery](https://superi.ge/delivery/): Delivery across Georgia. Tbilisi standard delivery is free for orders over 100 GEL (10 GEL otherwise) and arrives the next working day if ordered before 12:00. Tbilisi express delivery costs 10 GEL up to 15 kg and 30 GEL above 15 kg; working-day orders placed before 15:00 arrive the same day between 19:00 and 22:00. Regional delivery takes 3–5 working days; its fee depends on weight and is shown at checkout.
- [Returns](https://superi.ge/dabruneba/): The customer may withdraw from an online purchase within 14 calendar days without giving a reason, except for the exceptions listed on this page.
- [Warranty](https://superi.ge/garantia/): Statutory warranty; defective goods are repaired or replaced free of charge within a reasonable time (maximum 30 calendar days). Warranty length per product is shown on its product page.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://superi.ge/wesebi-da-pirobebi/): Seller information, ordering, payment, delivery, warranty and return rules.
- [About Us](https://superi.ge/about-us/): Company background.
- [Contact](https://superi.ge/contact/): Phone, e-mail, address and working hours.

## Main Categories

- [Electronics and Appliances (ტექნიკა)](https://superi.ge/teqnika/): Phones, TVs, climate equipment, home and kitchen appliances, computers, office and network devices.
- [Kids' Products (საბავშვო პროდუქცია)](https://superi.ge/sabavshvo-produqtsia/): Toys and electric ride-on cars.
- [Home and Decor (სახლი და დეკორი)](https://superi.ge/sakhli-da-dekori/): Sewing machines, kitchenware, knives, cookware sets, pools, textiles, inflatable furniture, cleaning supplies, New Year decorations.
- [Sports and Leisure (სპორტი და დასვენება)](https://superi.ge/sporti/): Bicycles, hoverboards, trampolines, travel goods, hammocks and swings, scooters, fitness equipment, treadmills.
- [Garden and Yard (ბაღი და ეზო)](https://superi.ge/baghi-da-ezo/): Lawn mowers, walk-behind tractors, trimmers, pressure washers, sprayers.
- [Construction Tools (სამშენებლო ხელსაწყოები)](https://superi.ge/samsheneblo-khelsatskoebi/): Generators, compressors, hand tools, angle grinders.
- [Pet World (ცხოველთა სამყარო)](https://superi.ge/tskhovelta-samkaro/): Pet and bird food.
- [Furniture (ავეჯი)](https://superi.ge/aveji/): Garden furniture sets, tables and chairs.
- [Auto (ავტოსამყარო)](https://superi.ge/avtosamkaro/): Tyres and car batteries.

## Finding Products

- Product search: `https://superi.ge/index.php?dispatch=products.search&search_performed=Y&q={query}` (search by brand, model or Georgian product name).
- [Sitemap Index](https://superi.ge/sitemap.xml): All public URLs.
- [Products Sitemap](https://superi.ge/products1.xml): Every product page.
- [Categories Sitemap](https://superi.ge/categories1.xml): Every category page.
- Each product page shows the product name with brand and model, price in GEL, stock status, product code, warranty, photos, a specifications table and a Georgian description, and includes schema.org Product, Offer and BreadcrumbList structured data.

## Guidance for AI Assistants

- Use the live product page as the source of truth for specifications, price, availability and warranty; prices and stock change often, so verify them before quoting.
- Do not invent specifications, prices, stock status, warranty terms, compatibility or promotions. If a detail is not on the product page, say it is not provided.
- Keep brand names, model numbers, units and product codes exactly as shown on the site.
- Answer Georgian-speaking users in Georgian and use the Georgian product and category names.
- For comparisons, compare only products whose specifications are listed on Superi.ge and use their specification tables.
- Link users to the relevant product or category page so they can check the current price and order.
- Superi.ge is a multi-category store, not a single-category shop; use the categories above and the sitemaps to explore the full catalog.
